posts.author: XavionFrost_77
posts.body:
It's hard to place the issue; there are a lot of things that could be causing this.
Is your face image ".png"? If so, is it ".png" or ".PNG"? If the face images are not png files, they need to be converted to png files.
If the files are not the issue, then can you test what happens when you change the image to a different face image? It might be calling on a nonexistent file.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
What is the full folderpath to your project, beginning with the drive letter?
"This PC" is a shortcut under Windows, all true path begin with a drive letter like "C:\"
You can find the full path by right-clicking any picture in the windows explorer and select "Properties", then it should be one of the first lines in the next window.
